verdict.rationale: Replit's template workflow says you turn a design into a functional site with Agent, "test it in Preview, and publish a live URL", so a pre-publish preview is part of the build flow. Separate Development and Production environments support testing before publishing, but there is only one explicit mention of Preview and little detail on how you interact with it. Missing for 10: detailed docs on interacting with the live preview (clicking through flows, hot reload as Agent edits), preview behavior outside the template flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
